# use-typography

Expanded LLM context for the RustUse typography facade.

- Canonical facade crate page: https://rustuse.org/use-typography/
- Facade overview page: https://rustuse.org/facades/use-typography/

- Full RustUse context: https://rustuse.org/llms-full.txt

## Routing notes

The canonical short routes are https://rustuse.org/use-typography/llms.txt and https://rustuse.org/use-typography/llms-full.txt. The /facades/use-typography/ routes serve this exact generated content so the two paths cannot drift.
